messages.text: Pension clients are lighting up my phone. Quarter-end rebal tickets coming, equities lighter after the H1 run. Anyone have a read on size?
Model has the 60/40 universe needing to sell roughly $18bn of US equity into the close. Bonds have underperformed, so the drift is mostly to the upside on equity weight.
That's a decent chunk. Expecting MOC imbalances to skew sell. I'll hold back on the passive stuff until after 3:30.
Fwiw my number is lower, closer to $12bn. Equities were flat to down in June, so drift isn't as bad as the H1 run suggests.
Fair, you're using month-end drift and I'm using the quarter. Gap is just the lookback window. Either way it's a net seller.
Two of my accounts want to get ahead of it and sell now rather than at the print. Thoughts on working it through the afternoon?
I'd do 40% in VWAP now, rest into the close. Spreads are tight at the moment, no point paying up late if imbalances get ugly.
Agree. Keep participation under 8% so we don't leak. I can pull the intraday volume curve if useful.
Works. I'll send the first tranche to OMS now, flagging them as VWAP with a 3:45 end time.
Orders are staged in OMS. Blotter is lagging a bit on fills though, TradeBlotter P&L looks stale by a couple of minutes. Anyone else seeing it?
Yeah, mine is behind too. Probably just pricing refresh lag. I'd trust the OMS fills over the blotter for now.
Early imbalance indication is showing sell-side skew. Looks like the pension selling is real, about $2bn so far at the 3:00 look.
Good call getting ahead of it. Our fills are averaging a touch better than VWAP. Will confirm with the clients after the close.
